title: Line up an irregular meter with an as-of join
prompt:
`grid(ts)` is a one-minute timeline from 12:00 to 12:30. `power(ts, kw)` is a meter that reports whenever it likes, never exactly on the minute.

For every minute in `grid`, attach the most recent power reading taken **at or before** that minute. Keep the minutes before the first reading too; their `kw` is NULL. Columns `ts`, `kw`, ordered by ts.
hints: An equality join on ts matches nothing, because the meter never reports exactly on the minute. You need "the latest row whose time is ≤ mine".

DuckDB's `ASOF JOIN ... ON grid.ts >= power.ts` picks, for each grid row, the power row with the largest ts that satisfies the condition. Plain ASOF JOIN drops grid rows with no match; ASOF LEFT JOIN keeps them with NULLs.
SELECT g.ts, p.kw FROM grid g ASOF LEFT JOIN power p ON g.ts >= p.ts ORDER BY g.ts
